response.justification: The candidate has genuine geospatial experience (founding GISCollective, Green Map GIS work) and has built low-latency, high-throughput backend systems in DLang, which demonstrates systems-programming aptitude conceptually adjacent to C++. However, hands-on modern C++ experience is limited to a brief 2014–2015 stint and a thesis project, there is no Rust, and no navigation/routing pipeline experience. Recent roles have been TypeScript/Node full-stack product work, which is a significant distance from a C++-centric routing tiling pipeline role.
strengths: Founder-level geospatial/GIS domain experience (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk)
Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work in DLang (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Proven polyglot adaptability and willingness to learn beyond current expertise
concerns: Minimal recent modern C++ (last professional C++ role ended in 2015) and no Rust experience
No experience with navigation guidance, routing engines, or map tiling pipelines specifically
Recent career trajectory (2020–present) is TypeScript/web product work, far from systems-level pipeline engineering
